svg.text: Why one query for many requests is faster
Like a bus instead of a taxi per passenger: the trip to the database is the expensive part. Finding one row is cheap.
queue: waiting for a free connection
Every request is its own query and its own trip. With 2 connections, 6 requests take 3 trips, one after another.
Requests waiting at the same time share one query
batcher: takes everyone waiting right now
Each caller still asks for one key. The batcher sends the waiting keys as one query and hands each row back to its caller.
Simplified: 6 requests, 2 connections. Measured with 4,096 clients on one laptop: 18,289 → 252,161 req/s. One request alone has nothing to share: both take ~0.3 ms.
